Had been to this restaurant last week. The ambiance is good, food is really good, no wait times even during rush hour.
The only thing I was unhappy about was the fact that there was no menu given to us or anyone on that particular day. I am not sure if this is the scenario on a regular basis, but the lack of choice made us order from the limited items told by the waiting staff.
Because of this, we were shocked when we saw the price while paying the bill. I have been to restaurants on highways where sometimes we have to order from what waiting staff says, but it’s usually from restaurants which serve meals, but this was a multi cuisine restaurant.
But I am giving the benefit of the doubt and recommend this restaurant to have the tasty Mulbagal dosa and the dip vada.

reviews.author: The Verdict
reviews.text:
​Had a wonderful dining experience at Aradhya Grand, Devanahalli!

​Food Highlights:​
Tried both South Indian Thalis featuring Holige and Pheni.
​Delicious spread with porial, dal, sambar, veg kurma, rasam, hot rotis, rice, baby corn salad, bitter gourd chutney, and fryums.

​Sweets galores:
Delicious rice kheer plus a lovely surprise scoop of butterscotch ice cream at the end!

​Service & Ambiance:
​Friendly, attentive customer service.
​Comfortable and neat dining space.
​Very clean and well-maintained restroom facilities.

​Verdict: Incredible value for money. Highly recommended if you're in or passing through Devanahalli!
